MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The smart plug would let me control a lamp through my Echo devices, adding a useful function to equipment I already have.",
    "Alexa compatibility fits my recent Echo Dot, Echo Show, and stand purchases, especially when an item helps me do more with those devices."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The streaming sticks repeat a role already covered by my recent Fire TV Stick 4K Max bundle; sharing Alexa features does not give me a reason to buy another one.",
    "The older Fire tablets do not address a current need. My Echo Show purchase does not mean I also want a separate tablet.",
    "Memory cards and an HDMI cable fit things I have used before, but I have no current storage expansion or cable need. The wired earbuds also lack a clear connection to what I am setting up now."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My Amazon device purchases seem to have been treated as interest in more Amazon devices, regardless of whether they add anything useful.",
    "My past accessory purchases seem to have been taken as an ongoing need for cards and cables, even though those purchases served particular needs at the time."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My recent 4K Max purchase already fulfills my streaming need, making another streaming stick less useful right now.",
    "My Echo Show stand purchase suggests interest in making devices I own more useful; the smart plug follows that same practical direction.",
    "My repeated interactions over the years do not mean I need replacements immediately. A useful addition or a specific compatibility need matters more than simple resemblance to an earlier purchase."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my interest in Alexa and electronics but often confused buying related devices with improving the setup I already own."
}
